item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines a minimal `Student(dspy.Module)` with one `dspy.ChainOfThought(\"question -> answer\")`, and `forward()` directly calls that predictor."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses a tiny exact-match metric and a one-example `Example(...).with_inputs(\"question\")` trainset suitable for offline COPRO evaluation."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Configures `DummyLM` deterministically with an initial instruction/prefix proposal and repeated task outputs, then wires it in via `dspy.configure(lm=lm)`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Builds `COPRO(metric=..., breadth=2, depth=1, init_temperature=1.4)`, compiles with the specified `eval_kwargs`, and inspects the returned compiled program object."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Reads `compiled.predictor.predict.signature.instructions` and asserts it exactly equals the optimizer-proposed instruction text."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Renders the compiled prompt via `dspy.ChatAdapter().format_system_message(...)`, prints it, and asserts the visible system message contains the proposed instruction."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
